newsitem.title: USA: Target sees Q3 share $0.22 to $0.25.
newsitem.headline: Target sees Q3 share $0.22 to $0.25.

text.p: Target Therapeutics Inc said on Monday that earnings for the quarter ended December 31 were expected to be in the range of $0.22 to $0.25 per share.
Speaking at a healthcare conference, Target president and chief executive, Gary Bang said that revenues in the company's third quarter were strong.
Target Therapeutics develops, manufactures and markets specialised disposable micro-catheters, guidewires, micro-coils, silicone balloons, embolics, and angioplasty products.
